notes.title: v6-7135 changelog
notes.content:
v6-7135 changelog
Neural network NPC interactable entities are officially opened

NPCs are divided into two camps, the Terran and the Demons, and the Terrans and the Demons are hostile
Each NPC is unique. When you die, it's gone
Each NPC has specific personality traits and behavioral traits
Each NPC has different likes and dislikes of behaviors and things
Each NPC has its own different network.

Depending on the player's relationship with the NPC, the attitude of the NPC will make different responses
The way to improve the relationship with NPCs is currently open to chatting, through chatting to get to know the NPCs you are interested in.

After the relationship with NPCs is good to a certain extent. You can customize the NPC's flesh and clothing

After the relationship with NPCs is good to a certain extent. When the player is attacked, or takes critical damage, the .NPC will support the player through spatial exercises

After the relationship with the NPC is good to a certain extent, the NPC will give away various props, spirit stones and players by email from time to time

When an NPC is attacked or takes fatal damage, it will call for help to the player

The ability to trade items with NPCs is not available at this time
The ability to team up with NPCs is not available at this time
For the time being, the function of dual cultivation with NPCs is not available
The function of NPC death drop storage bags and items is not available for the time being

The modifier of positive demonic nature after killing NPCs is not available for the time being

Remember to remember that NPC is not a simple logical AI, he is a neural network + genetic mutation algorithm,
Therefore any action you do to him will be learned by him. memory, and will also extend to his network of relationships.
And you will do everything. NPCs will do it. For example, alchemy, refining, demon refining, etc

Add full English language UI and text and related prop descriptions (tested)
Here's how to change the language:
Steam queries the file where the game is located
\UserData\GameSetting.json
Change "Language": "TW" to "Language": "EN" to English language

The game payment function is officially opened
Accounts that don't pay can still play normally, but they won't be able to interact with each other socially
[Can't form a party, can't trade, can't make friends, can't double cultivate, can't complete or post and receive bounties, can't use the Tianyuan Chamber of Commerce, can't use sects, can't build caves and houses, and any other related functions]

For more details, please refer to:
http://bbs.theworldgamestudio.com/forum.php?mod=viewthread&tid=16
Comprehensive, complete with open-world terrain

All exercises have added functions that require comprehension before they can be learned
The comprehension process is understood by the Taoist in the game

The Energy attribute is officially enabled
Energy attributes
Any non-combat mode action will be consumed
The game time will not be restored in a small amount
It can also be restored through dantian messages and using a variety of furniture, such as sleeping in bed. Sit in a chair

All in-game visible trees can be cut down
Obtained building materials and various wood resources

Cancel the original area Heart Source Secret Realm
Removed the original area of the Demon Soul Altar

The way to obtain the Mind Method has been modified to the treasure chest of the Secret Realm of Spiritual Qi Leakage

Added a large random area of the secret realm of aura leakage

The Secret Realm of Aura Leakage will spawn at a random time in a random location
The secret realm of aura leakage has various difficulty divisions and various restrictions
The secret realm of aura leakage has different difficulties. The rewards are different
The treasure chests in the secret realm where the aura leaks contain both normal treasure chests and decryption treasure chests

Added the Secret Realm of the Lock Demon Tower to select the floor you want to challenge
Note - This level will only be selected the next time you enter after successfully passing through
Floors are not shared in a party state. If the captain goes into the upper floor. If the team member doesn't have permission. Team members are not allowed to enter

Resets all item base stats and random stat parameter factors

Reset all task statuses .

Adjust the mailbox system to read a maximum of 50 entries at a time,
Entries that exceed will not be read. It will only be displayed after you clean up the email by yourself and read it again

Every time you change from a situation greater than zero to a spirit of longevity, you will get a chance to [Pray for God] the next time you log in
[Blessing to the heavens] will force the character to renew the life of the game time for 1 day, and Taoist friends can use this day to quickly make up for their own longevity

Wood Attribute Spirit Grass is mainly found in forest plains
Water Attribute Spirit Grass is mainly distributed in rivers, lakes, and seashores

Earth Attribute Spirit Grass is mainly found in plains

Tempering mainly affects the secondary attributes of the artifact, such as [Base Damage, Base Damage Modifier Percentage, Heart Damage, Heart Rate]

The third-level attributes of the magic weapon can be transformed through special materials.
The main affected attributes include [Max Durability, Max Charge, Charge Rate, and Weapon Qualification of Spell Weapon]
